note: Measured on 2026-09-14 against gameplay-export pack v10 (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v10-snapshot-20260913/fox-bf). Fixed since the prior baseline (49, shield, on P4's own Guard->GuardOff release): every ordinary (Ft_MF_None) Fighter_ChangeMotionState call unconditionally clears fp->x221A_b7 (the flag Fighter_ProcessHit_8006D1EC gates regeneration on), including every transition out of an active shield (begin_pass into Pass, the ordinary release into GuardOff via ftCo_80092F2C, and the roll/spot-dodge escape alike). The existing fix only modeled this for Pass (a narrow shield_active_into_pass flag at begin_pass's own call site); simulation::advance now snapshots shield::active(f) for every player up front, before that frame's own update_actions runs any transition, and threads that single shield_active_at_frame_start value to shield::finish_frame directly, covering GuardOff/Pass/the roll uniformly. Generalizing surfaced the same 0.07-short discrepancy an earlier broadening attempt had hit and left alone: the roll's own conversion frame had been regenerating under the old, narrower gate (checked after the transition) even though it should not; game_escape's own regeneration test needed one more intermediate step before its final assertion to match the corrected timing. Confirmed against fox-bf.slp: P4's Guard->GuardOff at frame 49 now lands on 57.46872329711914 (was 57.53872299194336, 0.07 too high). 273 frames now match (-123 through 149); the new first divergence is frame 150, field action_state on P4 (expected Dash, actual Turn) -- the same class of Turn-to-Dash conversion divergence already fixed once on this recording (frame 33), not yet re-diagnosed for this instance.
